changes.title: Taut chain smooth
items: Pulling a creature's chain from the treetops now brings you down to the ground in one smooth glide, with no drop at the end; let go at any height and you rise again

changes.title: Planted feet
items: The animals' feet now stay planted as they walk and run instead of sliding: each has a slow walk and a proper run, and picks between them by how fast it's going
Their bodies move as they go: they bob, sway and roll, bounders stretch out and gather, heads stay steady and tails follow
The mole's great hands paddle in time with its steps, and the baby bee no longer dips to the ground

changes.title: Mesh creatures
items: Home's animals are redrawn as low-poly models on skeletons: fox, stoat, hare, squirrel, dormouse, badger, mole, hedgehog and snail, each with its own baby, young, adult and legend
A giant bee now lives in the old pinewood in the marten's place: it flies, and stings from range
A turtle now lives in the Fen in the newt's place: slow and armoured, it spits a jet of pond water, and sleeps in its shell
They walk on eight frames instead of two, and legends wear plate armour cut with glowing runes
Asleep they lie down; sleeping legends curl up in a ring, nose to tail, and the snail draws into its shell

They stand on the ground now instead of floating over it, and stride properly: the fox trots, the hare, stoat, squirrel and dormouse bound, the badger, mole and hedgehog trot low, and each stands still on all its feet when it stops

changes.title: Taut chain
items: Up in the treetops, pulling against a creature's chain drags you down: a short tug dips you and you rise again; keep pulling and you come down to the ground
On the ground, pulling a creature's chain slows you much less, and the creature hurries after you
Keep pulling on the ground and you'll see that creature's sigil slide out of your stack; ease off and it slides back, keep going and it drops where you are
A legend's chain yanks you back instead
Adult chains are bigger than young ones, and legend chains bigger still
Chains are a softer silvery violet, with a flash of the creature's colour running along them now and then

changes.title: Terrace no transition
items: Walking between the treehouse terrace and its rooms no longer swings the camera or changes the light: the house is one place now

changes.title: Station none cards
items: At the dressing stations, the None and Bare cards now show her without it (no sunglasses, bare ears, no cloak, no scarf), and the Trainers card shows her trainers, instead of a ∅
At the Workshop, a broom slot's empty card shows the plain broom there: the handle's bare end, the plain handle, or her straw bristles

changes.title: Ranged lead
items: Creatures' shots now aim where you're going: keep changing direction to dodge
Shots fly faster, and a creature stands still for a moment before it lets go
Tigers' and cats' adult claws, and young rhinos' logs, no longer leave a safe gap right where you stand
